# ECS

Manage clusters, task definitions, tasks, and services with optional Docker execution.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `ecs` |
| Signing name | `ecs` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2014-11-13` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records / optional Docker |
| Selected operations | 25 of 77 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

- Clusters, task definition revisions, service desired count and task lifecycle.
- Capacity provider metadata and tags.
- Optional Docker runner starts containers, exposes host ports and captures awslogs output.
- Services replace tasks when essential containers exit.

## Limitations and future work

- Records mode starts no containers.
- Docker mode omits health checks, secrets, volumes, dependencies, task networking and resource limits.
- No container instances, load balancer integration, Service Connect, placement or execute command.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
